# Cora Vance

Fictional letter writer: a sales letter should read like a note from a friend, told as a story. Part of [[copywriting-legends]].

## Core ideas
- **Story first:** open on a person in a moment of tension, not on the product.
- **Conversational rhythm:** short sentences, then a longer one, read aloud to test it.

## What to steal
- **The P.S. restatement:** the last line restates the cost of doing nothing.
